pending_ideas.hook: She submerges a bright blue laundry basket upside-down into a drum of wet concrete, pushing it all the way under until bubbles stop.
pending_ideas.why: Large water-holding object hits the proven scale pattern (kiddie pool 644k, umbrella fountain 95k) and the submerging moment looks like total destruction of something everyone owns.
pending_ideas.tr: Çamaşır sepetini betonun içine batırıp bahçe havuzu yapıyor.

pending_ideas.hook: She fills a wheeled yellow mop bucket to the brim with grey concrete mix, then rams a thick post down the center.
pending_ideas.why: Tier 1 water feature with instant recognition—the wheels and wringer make it unmistakable—and filling destroys its original purpose in three seconds.
pending_ideas.tr: Paspas kovasını betonla doldurup kuş banyosu yapıyor.

pending_ideas.hook: She dips a deflated, muddy soccer ball completely into a bucket of concrete, coating every panel and stitch.
pending_ideas.why: Coated objects with visible detail (seams, panels) hold 18k-29k views and a recognizable sports item creates the value-gap story instantly.
pending_ideas.tr: Eski futbol topunu betona batırıp taş saksı yapıyor.

pending_ideas.hook: She pours concrete directly into an old wicker basket, flooding the weave until it soaks through and drips onto the ground.
pending_ideas.why: The wicker texture will cast beautifully (detail retention like garments at 18k-29k) and pouring into something meant to hold food reads as irreversible damage.
pending_ideas.tr: Piknik sepetinin içine beton döküp bahçe saksısı yapıyor.

pending_ideas.hook: She wraps a metal fan cage in cloth soaked in concrete, squeezing grey slurry through every wire square with her hands.
pending_ideas.why: The spherical wire grid is instantly recognizable and hand-squeezing wet concrete through metal creates the hard-middle moment that coated objects need to retain.
pending_ideas.tr: Vantilatör kafesini betonla kaplayıp taş küre yapıyor.
